context: v2 of the C++ conjugate 7->9 growth-repair seam annealer (m=4); design-route guidance from growth_seam_design_ledger_m4.json wired into the move generator

v2_features.G3_parity_early_reject: per-(layer,color) permutation signs cached by row hash; sign(return_c) = prod_t sign(L_{t,c}) is exact, so parity penalty (3000/+1 sign) + 400*skipped lower-bounds the proposal energy before any compose-count; Metropolis draw shared between bound test and full test (statistically identical acceptance); predicted signs cross-checked against the evaluator on every full eval (signmis counter)
v2_features.G2_keep_coverage_repair: move post-condition repair pass: donation cell conflicts re-offset to free storeys (or dropped), stairs moved off donated columns, gated donor keep-coverage (every (z0,z1) storey of every donated column keeps >= 1 ungated movable layer for its donor color) repaired by dropping an offending donation
v2_features.G1_color_purity_bias: new donations prefer the target leaf's dominant donated color (p=0.7); deletions prefer minority colors (p=0.6) - ledger T2b: full mixed-color leaf words are never single
v2_features.M_leaf_merge_move: with prob --merge-prob (default 0.10): build current plan, label the worst leaf's return cycles, take the PARASITE columns (x-support of the non-giant cycles) as the candidate set and enumerate stairs (t != tau_s, x in parasite cols, all b) whose m gated cells straddle >= 2 distinct return cycles (cell i at stage t is on the cycle of its forward image through layers t..m-1); propose a PAIR of such boundary stairs (one stair flips the sign of both leaf returns - the v1 parity-pair rule - so lone stairs are parity-dead, measured 0/726 accepted; with only one boundary stair found, compensate by deleting an existing stair or adding a random one)

lessons_machine_checked.stair_parity: a single leaf stair flips sign of BOTH leaf returns: merge proposals must come in parity pairs (counter evidence: merges=0/726 then 0/50211 accepted before the pair fix; sign probe on the E=6 plan: every single block stair gives leaf7 5->4, leaf8 1->2, dE=0 but +6000 parity)
lessons_machine_checked.static_keep_coverage_too_strict: the per-(z0,z1)-storey static gated keep-coverage test is NOT a necessary condition - fiber coordinates evolve through the layer word, so statically fully-gated storeys can still be traversed; the clean E=6 plan violates the static test on 3 columns (deleting them exploded E to 1898); pass 3 now enforces only the safe condition: column dead iff EVERY movable layer carries a full gate mask on one axis
lessons_machine_checked.uniform_x_scan_useless: boundary stairs live on a handful of parasite columns (4 of 4096 at the E=6 state); uniform-x candidate scans found one in ~7 percent of attempts, the parasite-column enumeration finds all of them deterministically

plan_format: UNCHANGED from v1 (donations/stairs/wilds/lines/oswaps + cross0/cross1 + tau_s); hit path scripts/growth_conjugate_hit_m4.json, atomic write, cache-free re-verify before writing - copied verbatim from v1

pinned_invariant.statement: at the E=6 frontier the four residual leaf-7 cycles all live on ONE 4-column base-orbit block x in {2644,2645,2646,2647} and are exact z1-TRANSLATES of a single closed gated loop (cycle k = cycle 0 shifted by T_(0,k) in the fiber): a fiber-coset family, not four independent defects
pinned_invariant.evidence: /tmp/gcv/e6_deep.txt (machine output: states of the four 8-cycles listed; identical column support; (x,z0,z1) state sets related by z1 += k mod 4; block columns are multiply donated by colors 0,1,3,6 at layers 2,3 on both axes)
pinned_invariant.consequence: one z1-asymmetry on the block boundary (a leaf stair at a donation-free layer of those columns, e.g. t=0, or a re-offset of one gating donation) breaks the translation symmetry and merges the whole coset family with the giant cycle; the v2 leaf-merge move class proposes exactly such stairs, and stairs at layers 0 remain admissible there (donations on the block sit at layers 2,3 only)
pinned_invariant.status: frontier diagnosis, not a family-killing floor: the obstruction is a movable coset defect, no conserved quantity prevents E=0
